# Pixel Street

> Pixel Street is a web design, branding and digital marketing agency based in
> Salt Lake, Kolkata, India. This blog covers branding, web design, web development,
> e-commerce, SEO and AI search optimisation.

Contact: info@pixelstreet.in | +91 90072 95096
Author: Khurshid Alam, Founder

## How to read this site cheaply

- [Machine view of the blog](https://pixelstreet.in/blog/ai/): every article, plain text, one request.
- Any article has a machine twin at `/blog/ai/<slug>/` and a Markdown mirror at `/blog/<slug>.md`.
- [Machine view of the whole site](https://pixelstreet.in/ai): the agency, its services, its work.
- Each article lists its own sources — publisher, URL, publication date — so a figure can be checked at origin.
